About me

Gluten-free shouldn't mean settling.

I'm Esther, the creator behind Gluten-Free with Esther. Eating gluten-free means asking a lot of questions before you order, and a lot of disappointing bites along the way. So I do the searching, tasting, and asking, and share what's actually worth it.

My Reels cover gluten-free restaurants around LA, new products on the shelf, and honest reactions, so my audience can skip the guesswork and go straight to the good stuff.

Why work with me

Content for people who read every label.

A gluten-free audience doesn't scroll past food content. They save it, share it, and use it to decide where to go next.

  • A focused audiencePeople who follow me are actively looking for gluten-free products and places to eat.
  • Honest reactionsReal first bites and opinions, which is what makes a recommendation worth trusting.
  • Real-life contextI show how your product or menu actually fits into a gluten-free day.
  • Ready to postShort-form video that's shot, edited, and made for Reels and TikTok.
